notes.title: Free demo coming soon! Team K's latest work is scheduled for April 28th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43097082/e43472dd1736dac0d6d2437e55a7fdb8fb0b8fbd.png[/img]

Hi, gentlemen.
The latest work from the team of "to be or not to be" and "Lost: Find" from a friend - "Build the Garden of Easden" " will be officially released on [u][b]April 28[/b][/u]! This time, the Team K team once again brought a demo to the gentlemen for everyone to experience.
"Build the Garden of Easden" "is a brand new work that is different from the previous game types of DSGAME. This work adopts the theme of traveling through different worlds with elements of cultivating immortals. In terms of gameplay, it chooses the Roguelike auto chess game that emphasizes both strategy and leisure. Players will play the young master of the Acacia Sect in the world of cultivating immortals, and meet girls from different worlds with different personalities and backgrounds. , Start a big adventure in a different world harem!

If you are interested in the gameplay, plot or art style of this work.[b][u]Please add this to your wishlist.[/u][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2356360/_/

Please note: the trial demo does not represent the final quality of the game! The core gameplay, plot context, and art style of the trial demo are basically the same as the official version, but the project team is still stepping up the final optimization of each module, hoping to present better effects for gentlemen in the official version!

notes.title: 2023.3.6 version update instructions
notes.notes:
Thanks for player feedback and comments

We have optimized some content of the game:
1. Fixed the resource display problem in the hidden ending
2. Corrected the problem of getting wrong props instead of gold coins after winning the game
3. The whack-a-mole game with the man in black can now be skipped by [b]drugs[/b]
4. After accepting the task of [Cute Pendant], add a prompt that can be exchanged for medicines by looking for NPCs
5. Optimized the rewards for the bartender's first mission, and added a drug reward

Note: In order to achieve better results, some specific rooms in the game use ion smoke and lighting effects, and only players with nuclear graphics cards entering the room may cause crashes. I'm very sorry, our technical optimization is not good enough, please forgive me.
